Hi everyone —

Confirmed: Thu Nov 6, 09:00–09:30 PT. Thank you all for adjusting. Apologies for the delayed calendar — we recorded the session and the recording & materials are attached.

Attachments included: Group-Demo-Agenda.pdf, redwood-office-hours.ics
Recording link: https://redwood.app/recordings/20251106-office-hours (posted to the HubSpot event linked above)

Key notes from session:
- Live prompts: short search re-ranker and contextual chat; average median latency (50th) for 512-token response on our dedicated pool: 42 ms/token using 8-bit quantization.
- Recommended starter config for prototyping: small dedicated pool, prefix caching enabled, async batching window 10–20 ms.
- Follow-up: Rafael will share prompt set and a short runbook for pre-warming.

If you want a dedicated 1:1 deep-dive for your infra and SLOs, reply and we’ll schedule.
